name: Prosper
overview: Scripture reveals that true prosperity stems from God's sovereign plan and blessing, as He created all things and holds our future in His hands. Believers are called to trust in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on their own understanding, for the righteous are promised treasure and peace, while wickedness leads to trouble. God's intentions toward His people are for their good and a hopeful future, and through Christ, we receive not only life but abundant life beyond mere material gain.
